The target video is a living aged tempera painting in <Subject 1>: the cracked pigment and dry-brush texture stay visible on every surface as it moves, and the light changes like paint glazing over paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The warm windows flicker softly behind their curtains, and a curtain stirs as if someone had just walked past. Fog drifts slowly across the wet cobblestones. The camera glides forward down the middle of the street at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, the lit houses sliding past on both sides, while the blue dusk deepens into night and the small church at the end of the street grows larger until it closes the view in the center, its bell tower rising above. The camera is still gliding forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
